gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: I'm really looking forward to ___ you again soon.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: 'to' is a preposition here.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: The car ___ down on the motorway and had to be towed.
I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.
